paragraphs: The M3 Touring has been a mainstay of the M3 diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early G81 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the G81 and later the G81, the M3 Touring switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The M3 Touring is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The M3 Touring uses a single engine family across its production run: the S58. Because there is only one engine code, compatibility is straightforward — but we still confirm your exact VIN and registration before any work starts to ensure we match the correct ancillaries, ECU calibration, and drivetrain configuration. This is why we always begin with your registration: it protects you from ordering parts that don't fit your specific car.
